old_problem: The historical record left BF4 cable identity, endpoint pair, vendor handling procedure and link oracle as an Engineering Decision although the one-cycle physical objective and safe parameterized method were clear.
disposition_reason: ED-03/07/08/09/20 permit cable/port identities and project link limits as runtime inputs, while the physical-operation rule assigns disconnect/reconnect to a qualified technician. A single signed cable path, vendor service state and read-only pre/post link evidence form a complete safe case; absent bindings block execution, not review resolution.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2191, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2192 / Wistron-HW-00472-V003 / 01b5cce7f4c59ad7 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Bind BF4 cable PN/serial/length and exact source/destination board-port pair, direction/keying/latch/bend route.
Use signed vendor both-endpoint power state, ESD and disconnect/reconnect method; qualified technician handles connector housing only.
Capture unique two-endpoint/route photos and compare exact BF4 endpoint, firmware/driver, link state and errors before/after.
Preserve logs; prohibit force, cable-body pulling, live unapproved service, repeated cycling, neighbor evidence reuse and automatic retry.
No cable handling, power action, link query/reset/retrain, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox BF4 cable service and link restoration
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved BF4 cable disconnect/reconnect restores correct endpoint pairing, latch/route and the same qualified BF4 device/link state without damage or new errors.
required_package: BF4 cable identity and two-ended port map
test_case.test_command: Record labeled BF4 endpoints/route and read-only device/link/error baseline. Technician places both endpoints in the approved service state, disconnects/reconnects the exact cable once using connector housings, verifies latch/keying/bend route, then restores readiness. Collect unique photos and full endpoint/firmware/driver/link/error/log evidence; do not repeat or retrain/reset.
test_case.expected_result: The exact BF4 cable is undamaged, correctly keyed/latched/routed between signed ports, and the identical endpoint returns with required link attributes and no prohibited errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when physical evidence and every signed endpoint/link/error criterion match. Damage, swap/misroute/mis-latch, missing endpoint, downgrade or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing runtime cable/map/procedure/oracle is BLOCKED before handling.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until cable/ports, both-endpoint service state, authorization and recovery are signed.
Qualified technician only; vendor ESD/power/latch/bend controls apply.
No force, cable-body pull, unapproved live work, repeat, reset/retrain, log clear or retry.
Stop on resistance, damage, mismatch, incomplete latch, missing/degraded link or errors.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and cable identity
Signed port map, direction/keying/latch/bend route and service procedure
Unique pre/during/post photos of both connectors and route
Pre/post endpoint, firmware/driver, negotiated link and error/event evidence
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on physical or link discrepancy. Leave endpoints in the approved safe state and escalate to the owner; use only signed recovery, never a second reconnect or automatic retrain/reset.
